critical_steps: The projection P onto the first central summand has adjoint equal to the inclusion.
Every adjointable T from A to Ap satisfies T(P*P)=T, giving the Parseval operator-module frame identity.
The nonzero vector q in the second summand is annihilated by P and is outside every range R(T*).
A unit vector in the coefficient module supplies explicit rank-one adjointable maps realizing every y as T*e.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact Hilbert-module identities over the finite-dimensional C*-algebra C⊕C.
integrity.unproved_limits: The sufficient repair is not asserted to be an exact characterization of all module pairs for which the equivalence holds.

scientific_limitations: The result disproves only the converse direction of the stated frame/g-frame equivalence for arbitrary Hilbert C*-modules.
The unit-vector condition on the coefficient module is sufficient for repair but is not claimed necessary.
No classification of all Hilbert-module pairs satisfying adjoint reachability is asserted.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same source-specific observation.
title: Adjoint reachability is missing from a Hilbert-module frame equivalence
